BUSINESS AI LAB

Dr. Thien Van Luong · Founder & Lab Leader

Connecting foundational AI with real-world impact.

Dr. Thien Van Luong is a lecturer at the Faculty of Data Science and Artificial Intelligence, National Economics University, and the founder of Business AI Lab. His research spans applied AI for business and finance, computer vision, NLP, IoT and advanced wireless communications, with over 50 peer-reviewed publications in leading venues including IEEE Transactions and Journal of Lightwave Technology.

02 · RESEARCH AGENDA

From intelligent systems to better decisions.

View all research →
01

AI for Business & Finance

Forecasting, decision intelligence and trustworthy machine learning for complex markets. We develop explainable AI models that help organizations make better decisions under uncertainty.

02

Computer Vision & NLP

Turning visual and language data into measurable insights for people and organizations. Our work spans document understanding, scene analysis, and multimodal AI systems.

03

Connected Intelligent Systems

AIoT, cyber-physical systems and next-generation wireless communication. We research how intelligent systems can collaborate and communicate in real-world environments.
